g.text: The reminders epic: a patient is reminded before appointments (US-16), before events
(US-31) and at medication times (US-32), and chooses which in the notification
preferences (US-37). A caregiver can be reminded of the patient's (US-21, US-33, US-34).
Saving an appointment, an event or a prescription reschedules its reminders;
a notification opens the appointment, event or prescription it is about.
